# Falcon Drone v1 — Product Specification

## Overview

The Falcon Drone v1 is Aurora Robotics' original industrial inspection drone, released in 2021 for pipeline and utility infrastructure inspection. It was designed to replace manual crawl-and-climb inspection methods with a faster, safer, autonomous alternative.

## Flight Performance

The Falcon Drone v1 has a maximum flight time of 35 minutes on a single battery charge, with an operational range of 5 kilometers from the ground control station. The drone uses a swappable lithium-ion battery pack that recharges fully in approximately 45 minutes, allowing field crews to keep a drone flying continuously by rotating batteries.

## Payload and Sensors

The Falcon Drone v1 supports a maximum payload capacity of 2.5 kilograms. The standard sensor package includes a 12-megapixel camera. An optional thermal imaging add-on module can be attached for inspections requiring heat signature detection, such as identifying insulation failures on pipelines.

## Primary Use Case

The Falcon Drone v1 was purpose-built for industrial pipeline inspection, allowing utility companies to visually inspect long stretches of pipeline infrastructure without dispatching ground crews. During 2021, several customers also began piloting the platform for agricultural inspection use cases.

## Control and Software

The Falcon Drone v1 is operated through Aurora Robotics' fleet management software, which provides live telemetry, flight path planning, and recorded footage review. Flight paths can be pre-programmed for repeatable inspection routes along known infrastructure corridors.
